title: How I Turned A Gas Station Visit Into A Multi-Million Dollar Business
channel: Chris Koerner on The Koerner Office Podcast
promo_conflict: Host is promoting his own store (texasnacks.com, Shopify) and offers to sell a giant beaver statue to viewers; the video is effectively an advert for Texas Snacks. It also depends on goodwill from BIES (Buc-ee's), which he calls an 'unofficial partner'.

stated_problem.quote: I noticed that that they didn't sell online.
stated_problem.speaker: Chris Koerner

idea.name: Texas Snacks (BIES/Buc-ee's online reseller)
idea.one_liner: Buy branded BIES snacks and merch at full retail and resell them online at about 40-100% markup to fans who can't get to a store.
idea.customer: BIES enthusiasts and Texan expats worldwide (consumers)
idea.offer: Online store selling BIES-branded snacks, jerky, candy, shirts, hats and plushies
idea.revenue_model: Retail markup on goods bought at full retail (e.g. $18 to $33-35 shirts, $5 to $9 nuggets, about 40% on jerky)

key_quotes.quote: spend millions of dollars a year full retail at this store on snacks and shirts
Really, the best sellers for us are things that have a BIES logo on it.
We've noticed that we have a really hard time selling even Texas branded things that are not BIES branded things.
Corporate did ask us to stop selling it because they weren't able to guarantee the freshness
We have a ton of competitors. It's a very hard business.
Well, we work with the store beforehand to place a large order.

claims.claim: They spend millions of dollars a year at full retail in the store
claims.quote: spend millions of dollars a year full retail at this store on snacks and shirts
These are priced at about $18 each.
We sell them for about $33 to $35 each.

claims.claim: Beaver nuggets bought at $5 and sold at $9
claims.quote: They sell these for $5. We sell them for $9.

claims.claim: Jerky costs $9 (small bag) and $16 (big bag), so margins are thin
claims.quote: The margins for us are not great on this because it's already $9 jerky for the smaller bags, $16 for the bigger bag.

claims.claim: Jerky is marked up only about 40%
claims.quote: We only marked this up about 40% because it's hard to justify paying $20 for a bag of jerky.

claims.claim: Candy bought at $4 a bag and sold at $8
claims.quote: We sell it for about $8 a bag and it does okay.

claims.claim: They sell thousands of dollars of stock every day
claims.quote: send an email, and we sell thousands of dollars worth of this stuff every single day.

claims.claim: A giant beaver statue cost about $2,000 and has never sold
claims.quote: I think we bought one of these and it cost about $2,000.

claims.claim: Initial outlay of about $3,000 buying one of everything
claims.quote: So, I spent about $3,000 buying one of everything to get By's attention.
I ended up launching a business that did $160,000 its first month.

claims.claim: Low margins; took several years to become profitable
claims.quote: The margins are not awesome. It took us a few years to even reach profitability, but now we have a big warehouse.
but now we have a big warehouse. We employ about a dozen people.

acquisition_channels.details: Went massively viral at launch, driven by the founder's story and content
Emails its own customer list when new stock is listed

ideas.delivery: Founders and staff pre-order from the store, collect palletised stock by box truck or Sprinter van, store it in their own warehouse, list it on Shopify and ship worldwide. About a dozen employees.
ideas.other_uk_rules: UK version would need: food business registration with the local authority and food labelling/allergen rules, Consumer Contracts Regulations for distance selling, UK GDPR and PECR (soft opt-in) for the email list, and trademark/brand-owner risk when reselling branded goods. The business depends on the brand tolerating it (they were asked to stop selling fudge).

idea.name: BIES mega gas station/travel-centre stores
idea.one_liner: Huge destination gas stations that use fuel as a loss leader and profit from in-store food, snacks and branded merch.
idea.offer: Fuel, prepared food (BBQ brisket), snacks, fudge, jerky, branded merch
idea.revenue_model: In-store retail and food margins; fuel as loss leader

key_quotes.quote: They do make a profit on gas, but it's more of a loss leader than anything.
One of the coolest things about BIES is that entire economies pop up around it when a new BIES opens.

claims.quote: These gas stations will have between 50 and 150 pumps.

claims.claim: The BBQ station does millions of dollars a year from one food
claims.quote: And they do millions of dollars a year in one food.

claims.claim: About 10% of floor space goes to non-BIES-branded goods
claims.quote: Bies dedicates about 10% of its floor space to, I call it, nonBies branded housear and goods.

acquisition_channels.details: Destination brand and highway location; not discussed in detail

ideas.delivery: Large staffed physical stores with on-site food preparation and retail
ideas.other_uk_rules: Petrol station licensing, food hygiene registration, planning permission, employment law

idea.name: Tesla Supercharger bays at destination stops
idea.one_liner: EV charging bays at high-traffic stops that earn per-kWh fees and bring in shoppers.
idea.revenue_model: Per-kWh charging fees (about 37 cents/kWh) plus extra in-store spend

key_quotes.quote: It's quite common for BIES locations to have between 10 and 40 Tesla supercharging stations.

claims.quote: It's quite common for BIES locations to have between 10 and 40 Tesla supercharging stations.

claims.claim: Drivers pay about 37 cents/kWh and then spend $200-300 in store
claims.quote: Tesla drivers pull off the freeway, park, they pay about 37 cents kilowatt hour, and then they go in and spend $200 or $300 on snacks and t-shirts.

acquisition_channels.details: Listed in the Tesla navigation/charging network at a highway stop

ideas.delivery: Tesla-installed and operated chargers on the site owner's land
ideas.other_uk_rules: Public Charge Point Regulations 2023 (contactless payment, pricing transparency); planning and grid connection

idea.name: Restaurants opening around new BIES sites
idea.one_liner: Open restaurants on the farmland next to a new mega gas station to catch the traffic it brings.
idea.customer: Travellers and visitors drawn by the anchor store

key_quotes.quote: All this stuff is going up and around BIES because it has that much of a multiplier effect.

claims.claim: About six restaurants have opened around one location
claims.quote: Now you've got this brand new massive HB. You've got half a dozen different restaurants.

acquisition_channels.details: Foot traffic generated by the anchor gas station

ideas.other_uk_rules: Food hygiene registration, premises licence, employment law

idea.name: Land speculation near new BIES sites
idea.one_liner: Buy land next to newly announced anchor developments, hold it while the area develops, then sell at a profit.
idea.customer: Developers and businesses wanting sites near the anchor

key_quotes.quote: Real estate investors, if they're savvy, can buy land near new BIES locations, sit on it, and profit.
7 years ago, there was nothing here. It was just farmland.

acquisition_channels.details: Not stated; implied sale to developers

ideas.delivery: Founder buys and holds land; little operational work
ideas.other_uk_rules: Stamp Duty Land Tax and Capital Gains Tax; planning risk; needs large capital
